title: Implement executeNewRemote (currently logs success doing nothing)
description: executor.executeNewRemote is a stub that logs 'New remote file pulled' without pulling. Implement doc fetch, conversion, frontmatter restore, folder creation, index registration.

title: Wire main.ts: commands, ribbon, status bar, debounce push, interval pull
description: main.ts is all TODO stubs; shipped bundle contains only the settings tab. Instantiate auth/APIs/index/tracker/engine, implement all commands, auto-push debounce, periodic sync, onunload cleanup.

title: OAuth loopback server + PKCE + token persistence
description: Sign In button is a no-op and no redirect listener exists, so auth flow cannot complete. Implement 127.0.0.1 loopback HTTP server, PKCE, encrypted token save/load on startup.

title: Suppress push echo from changes feed
description: Own pushes reappear in the changes feed, triggering spurious PULL of lossy round-tripped markdown (note degradation ping-pong). Record lastRemoteModifiedTime after push/pull and ignore non-newer changes.

title: Create .gdocs-sync dir before index/log saves
description: IndexManager.save and SyncLog.save ENOENT if .gdocs-sync missing; only saveAncestor ever mkdirs. mkdir recursive before writes.

title: Detect remote deletions/trashed files
description: removed:true changes are discarded and planner REMOTE_DELETE depends on allRemoteFiles which engine never populates. Track removed+trashed fileIds, plan REMOTE_DELETE.

title: Recursive Drive listing on first sync
description: listAllFiles(root) only lists direct children; subfolder docs invisible on first sync. Add recursive traversal and register folders.

title: Respect Drive 124-byte property limit for frontmatter storage
description: MAX_FRONTMATTER_PROPERTY_SIZE=30000 exceeds Drive's 124-byte key+value-per-property limit; frontmatter persistence fails for any real note. Chunk by UTF-8 bytes, cap chunks, skip+log oversized.

title: Paginate Drive changes feed
description: pullRemoteState ignores nextPageToken: >100 changes dropped and token reset to empty. Loop pages before storing newStartPageToken.

title: requestUrl throw:false + explicit HTTP error handling + wired retries
description: Obsidian requestUrl throws on status>=400 by default, making all status-based error handling dead code (drive.ts, docs.ts, auth.ts invalid_grant, rate limiter 429). Add throw:false everywhere, typed errors with status, wire MAX_RETRIES/RETRY_DELAYS_MS into RateLimiter.

title: crypto.randomUUID() may crash in older Electron/Node contexts
description: src/sync/planner.ts:58,74 — Uses crypto.randomUUID() without importing Node's crypto module. In Obsidian's Electron context the global crypto is the Web Crypto API which has randomUUID() in modern Chromium, but this is fragile and will crash in older Electron versions or Node-only test contexts. Should use an explicit import or fallback.

title: executeNewRemote() is a stub — new remote files never pulled
description: src/sync/executor.ts:284-288 — executeNewRemote() logs 'New remote file pulled' but does zero work. No API call, no file write, no index update. Any file created in Google Drive will never appear in the vault.

title: Add executor and engine test suites
description: executor.ts (401 lines) and engine.ts have zero tests; docs.ts too. Cover all op types, merge/conflict paths, sync flow, pagination, echo suppression.

title: Auto-create Drive root folder (drive.file scope fix)
description: With drive.file scope the app cannot open a user-pasted folder ID it didn't create. Create root folder by name on first sync; create _Deleted folder.

title: Enforce exclusion globs and max file size in sync path
description: Globs only applied in DirtyTracker; manual sync pushes excluded files. maxFileSizeMB never enforced. Filter in engine/change detection.

title: Plan LOCAL_RENAME from dirty metadata; re-dirty failed ops
description: DirtyFileEntry type/oldPath never consumed; local rename executes as delete+create destroying doc history. drain() loses intent on failed sync. Use rename info in planner, restore dirty set on failure.

title: Conflict modal: safe dismiss default + working open-in-editor
description: Dismissing the conflict modal silently resolves keep-local, discarding remote edits. Default to skip; make open-in-editor actually open the file.

title: executePush() detects mid-push file changes but never re-dirties the file
description: src/sync/executor.ts:143-146 — The code computes preHash and postHash, detects a change, logs 'will re-sync' but nothing adds the file back to the dirty set. The method returns void, not a flag. The file silently stays out-of-sync until the next full cycle.

title: Rate limiter double-counts retried requests
description: src/google/rate-limiter.ts:121,135 — On the initial attempt a timestamp is pushed at line 121. If a 429 is caught and retried, another timestamp is pushed at line 135 without removing the first. The same logical request consumes 2 slots in the window, causing the limiter to be more restrictive than intended and potentially stalling the queue.

title: Ribbon icon and status bar
description: Basic UI: sync ribbon icon with visual states (idle/syncing/error/conflict/offline), status bar item showing sync state.

title: Sync engine (engine.ts)
description: Core sync orchestrator: pre-flight checks, pull remote state, compute local state, plan, execute, post-sync. Manages sync lock. Tests: sync-engine.test.ts, push-pull-cycle.test.ts

title: Integrate merge into sync engine
description: Update sync engine to handle MERGE operations: export Google Doc to markdown, run three-way merge, apply result or show conflict modal. Tests: sync-engine.test.ts

title: Sync executor (executor.ts)
description: Execute planned operations in correct order: folders first, then renames, creates, content syncs, deletions last.

title: Mid-sync race condition handling
description: Pre-push hash snapshot + post-push re-hash. If file changed during push, add to dirty set for next sync cycle.

title: Ancestor snapshot management
description: Save/load/cleanup ancestor .md files in .gdocs-sync/ancestors/ after each successful sync. Used as common ancestor for three-way merge.

title: Sync planner (planner.ts)
description: Build operation plan from local + remote state comparison. Determines PUSH/PULL/MERGE/NEW/DELETE/RENAME operations for each file. Tests: planner.test.ts

title: Conflict resolution modal (conflict-modal.ts)
description: Obsidian modal showing side-by-side or unified diff. Options: Keep Obsidian Version, Keep Google Docs Version, Open in Editor. Tests: conflict-resolution.test.ts

title: Merge module (merge.ts)
description: Three-way diff and merge algorithm using node-diff3. Handles non-overlapping auto-merge, conflict detection, and 20% content-loss threshold (prompt if merged result <80% length of longer input). Tests: merge.test.ts

title: Dirty tracker (dirty-tracker.ts)
description: In-memory dirty-files set populated by Obsidian vault events (modify, create, delete, rename). Respects exclusion patterns. Tests: dirty-tracker.test.ts

title: Change detector (change-detector.ts)
description: Hash-based local change detection: compare current file hashes against stored localContentHash in index.json. Tests: change-detector.test.ts

title: Index manager (index-manager.ts)
description: index.json CRUD operations with atomic writes (temp file + rename). Tracks sync_id, paths, hashes, Drive IDs. Tests: index-manager.test.ts

title: Round-trip tests (roundtrip.test.ts)
description: Exhaustive round-trip tests: md → gdoc → md for all fixture files. Verify semantic equivalence, no content loss, output length within 10%, and stabilization after 3 round-trips.

title: Glob utility (glob.ts)
description: Glob pattern matching for file exclusions using micromatch/minimatch. Tests: glob.test.ts

title: Hash utility (hash.ts)
description: SHA-256 hashing utility for content change detection using Node crypto built-in. Tests: hash.test.ts

title: Google Docs to Markdown (gdoc-to-md.ts)
description: Full reverse pipeline: walk Google Doc body structure, convert paragraphs/lists/tables/formatting to markdown. Tests: gdoc-to-md.test.ts

title: Markdown to Google Docs (md-to-gdoc.ts)
description: Full conversion pipeline: parse markdown AST, transform Obsidian syntax, build Google Docs API batchUpdate request body. Tests: md-to-gdoc.test.ts

title: Google Docs formatting preservation (gdoc-formatting.ts)
description: Preserve Google Docs-only formatting (colored text, alignment, inline images) as HTML spans/comments in markdown. Reverse conversion back to Docs formatting. Tests: gdoc-formatting.test.ts

title: Docs API wrapper (docs.ts)
description: Google Docs API v1 wrapper: read document content (documents.get), write via atomic batchUpdate (delete range + insert). Uses requestUrl.

title: Obsidian syntax transforms (obsidian-syntax.ts)
description: Convert wikilinks, callouts, embeds, highlights, and tags to best-effort equivalents for Google Docs. Tests: obsidian-syntax.test.ts

title: Frontmatter handling (frontmatter.ts)
description: Extract frontmatter from markdown, store as Google Doc properties, restore on pull. Handle >30KB overflow with continuation properties. Tests: frontmatter.test.ts

title: Rate limiter (rate-limiter.ts)
description: Request queue with rate limit awareness for Google API quotas (Drive 12K/min, Docs 300/min). Handles HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Tests: rate-limiter.test.ts

title: Drive API wrapper (drive.ts)
description: Drive API v3 wrapper using Obsidian requestUrl: create/list/update/delete files and folders, changes.list for incremental sync. Tests: drive.test.ts

title: OAuth flow (auth.ts)
description: OAuth 2.0 login flow, token exchange, refresh token handling, encrypted storage in auth.json. Tests: auth.test.ts

title: Settings UI (settings.ts)
description: Settings tab with Google Cloud credential fields (Client ID, Client Secret), sync interval, auto-push toggle, exclusion patterns, and advanced options.

title: Types and constants (types.ts, constants.ts)
description: Define all shared TypeScript interfaces, API URLs, defaults, and magic numbers.

title: Plugin scaffold: manifest.json, package.json, esbuild, tsconfig, Jest
description: Set up the Obsidian plugin skeleton with manifest.json, package.json, esbuild config, tsconfig.json, and Jest test configuration.

title: Phase 4: Two-Way Sync & Conflict Resolution
description: Full two-way sync with three-way merge. Deliverable: Full two-way sync with auto-merge and conflict prompts.

title: Phase 3: Core Sync
description: One-way push and pull working end-to-end. Deliverable: Working one-directional sync (push local changes, pull remote changes, but not yet handling conflicts).

title: Phase 2: Conversion Engine
description: Reliable markdown ↔ Google Docs conversion. This is the highest-risk phase. Deliverable: Standalone conversion functions that pass all round-trip tests.

title: Phase 1: Foundation
description: Plugin skeleton, auth, and basic Drive operations. Deliverable: Plugin that can authenticate and list files in a Drive folder.

title: IndexManager reverse-lookup maps (O(1) path/driveId lookups)
description: getFileByLocalPath/getFileByDriveId are O(n) scans called per file per sync. Maintain byPath/byDriveId maps.

title: README accuracy pass
description: README documents features that were unreachable (commands, OAuth, auto-push). Update for wired behavior, alpha status banner, real settings table, token storage caveats, test counts.

title: Dedupe/tighten: atomic writes everywhere, remove dup methods, drop googleDocId, noUnusedLocals, ESLint
description: IndexManager duplicates atomic-write util; getFileBySyncId==getFile; googleDocId always equals driveFileId; unused imports; no linter in CI.

title: Obsidian guideline compliance: CSS classes, setHeading, password field, versions.json
description: Inline el.style.* in modals, createEl(h2) headings, client secret in plain text input, missing versions.json — all block community plugin submission.

title: Remove unused remark deps; fix parser bugs (intra-word underscore, tabs, nested bullets)
description: remark-parse/remark-stringify/unified declared but never imported. parseInlineFormatting italicizes snake_case; isListItem ignores tabs; list nesting computed but never applied to Docs requests.

title: pruneTimestamps uses <= instead of < at window boundary
description: src/google/rate-limiter.ts:83 — requestTimestamps[0] <= windowStart removes timestamps that fall exactly on the window boundary. Since the window is [now - windowMs, now], a timestamp at now - windowMs is still in-window and should not be pruned. This allows one extra request per window in edge cases.

title: executePush() conversion fallback re-converts raw Obsidian syntax
description: src/sync/executor.ts:105-108 — The catch block calls markdownToGoogleDoc(body) with the untransformed body containing wikilinks/embeds. If conversion failed, sending raw Obsidian syntax to Google Docs produces garbage. The fallback should send plain text, not re-attempt conversion without the transform.

title: SyncLog.load() — one corrupt JSONL line loses entire history
description: src/sync/sync-log.ts:16-23 — lines.map(line => JSON.parse(line)) throws on the first malformed line, the catch swallows the error and resets to []. Every valid entry is lost. Should wrap each line's parse individually.

title: Index recovery
description: If index.json is missing/corrupted: rebuild by scanning Drive for files with obsidian_sync_id property. Match local files by path and content hash. Prompt for unmatched files.

title: Conversion failure fallback
description: If markdown→Google Docs conversion fails, push raw markdown as plain text. Flag conversionFailed in index.json. Warn user via notice. Subsequent syncs retry.

title: Final integration testing
description: Full sync-engine.test.ts suite: all integration test scenarios including fresh install, steady-state, conflicts, errors, network failures. Ensure all tests pass with mocked APIs.

title: Large file skip logic
description: Skip files larger than configurable threshold (default 5MB) on both push and pull. Log warning, record skippedReason in index.json.

title: User documentation
description: Write docs/google-cloud-setup.md (GCP project setup guide), docs/known-limitations.md (lossy conversions, drive.file scope limits, frontmatter is Obsidian-only), docs/troubleshooting.md (common issues and recovery).

title: Offline handling
description: Network connectivity detection. Silent skip on timer-based sync, notice on manual sync. Dirty-set preserved across offline periods. Status bar shows offline state.

title: Network utility (network.ts)
description: Connectivity detection for offline handling. Used by sync engine pre-flight checks.

title: Deletion handling
description: Note deleted in Obsidian → move Google Doc to _Deleted folder. Google Doc deleted → prompt user (Yes/No/Ignore). Folder deletion cascades to contained files. Tests: deletion-lifecycle.test.ts

title: Rename/move sync
description: UUID-based identity tracking (obsidian_sync_id property). Bidirectional rename and move detection. Rename+move conflict: both ops apply independently. Tests: rename-move.test.ts

title: Initial sync modal
description: First-time setup: detect vault/Drive state, prompt direction (Push/Pull/Cancel). Progress bar with per-file status, cancel button, batch processing (50 files). Tests: initial-sync.test.ts

title: Atomic write utility (atomic-write.ts)
description: Harden all file writes: write to temp file, then rename. Handle write failures gracefully (preserve original). Tests: atomic-write.test.ts

title: Sync log modal (sync-log-modal.ts)
description: Viewer UI accessible from command palette (GDocs Sync: View Sync Log). Opens modal or leaf panel showing rolling log with timestamps, actions, and errors.

title: Sync log (sync-log.ts)
description: Rolling sync log with FIFO cap (default 1000 entries). Log entries: [timestamp] [action] [file] [result]. Actions: PUSH, PULL, MERGE, CONFLICT, DELETE, RENAME, MOVE, ERROR, SKIP, CONVERSION_FAIL. Stored in .gdocs-sync/sync.log.

title: Phase 6: Polish & Documentation
description: Sync log, docs, and final hardening. Deliverable: v0.1 release candidate.

title: Phase 5: File Lifecycle & Edge Cases
description: Deletion, renames, moves, and all edge case handling. Deliverable: Complete, production-ready sync with all edge cases handled.

title: Table cell index formula doesn't handle ragged markdown tables
description: src/conversion/md-to-gdoc.ts:607,629 — The table index formula assumes all rows have the same number of columns. Ragged markdown tables (rows with different cell counts) will produce wrong indices and corrupt the Google Doc. No validation normalizes row lengths before processing.

title: executeLocalDelete doesn't clean up index entry when Drive API throws
description: src/sync/executor.ts:290-301 — If deleteFile or moveFile throws, the exception propagates but the index entry is never cleaned up (line 303 is skipped). The file remains in the index as a ghost entry, causing future syncs to repeatedly attempt the delete.

title: SyncLog.save() uses bare fs.writeFile instead of atomicWriteFile
description: src/sync/sync-log.ts:27-29 — Uses bare fs.writeFile instead of the project's own atomicWriteFile utility. A crash mid-write corrupts the log. The rest of the codebase uses atomic writes for important data (index, tokens).
